data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 asserts that the §11.3 contradiction resolves once the temporal ordering of critic evaluations is reconstructed, but this defense presupposes that the ritual's own documentation actually contains such an ordering. A 'temporal misalignment' explanation is only viable if the text encodes the phase separation (e.g., by labeling the 'sound and relevant' affirmations and the 'failed' verdicts as belonging to distinct adjudication stages). If the ritual presents these contradictory assertions without any stage markers, the synchronic contradiction IS the fault: the target has not shown the ritual omits an ordering it was required to provide; it has merely assumed one exists to explain away the flag.
